### 1 — Scene
A vegetable plate with corn rounds, green beans, zucchini, leafy greens, cherry tomatoes, and white chunks that appear to be feta-style cheese (possibly tofu).

### 2 — Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 25–26 cm across. Using a **26 cm equivalent diameter**, its area is approximately **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Corn, white cheese, green beans, zucchini, spinach-like leaves, cherry tomatoes, and a light visible oil sheen.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas below allocate the food-covered footprint without counting overlapping items twice. Oil coats the food rather than occupying a separate area.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Density → grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Corn rounds | 14% | 74 × 2 = 148 ml | 0.65 → 96 g | 96 | 92 |
| Feta-style cheese | 10% | 53 × 1.5 = 80 ml | 0.95 → 76 g | 265 | 201 |
| Green beans | 10% | 53 × 0.9 = 48 ml | 0.60 → 29 g | 35 | 10 |
| Zucchini | 6% | 32 × 1 = 32 ml | 0.65 → 21 g | 20 | 4 |
| Leafy greens | 9% | 48 × 1.5 = 72 ml | 0.15 → 11 g | 23 | 3 |
| Cherry tomatoes | 4% | 21 × 2 = 42 ml | 0.60 → 25 g | 18 | 5 |
| Oil sheen | No additional footprint | Approximately 3 ml | 0.92 → 3 g | 884 | 27 |

**Coverage check:** 14 + 10 + 10 + 6 + 9 + 4 = **53%**, consistent with the substantial bare rim.

### 8 — Sanity check
Estimated food weight is **261 g**, with approximately **342 kcal**. This is plausible for a modest vegetable plate with cheese. Corn weight is an approximate edible-food estimate, excluding discarded cob. The white chunks are the main uncertainty: if they are tofu rather than feta, total energy would be closer to **250 kcal**.
